excavation_context.character_description: Adult male grad student museum preparator, short dark hair, tanned skin, wearing a light blue tee shirt under a crisp white lab coat, blue jean slacks, and black dress shoes. Wears signature thin-rimmed black rectangular lens glasses.

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_1 is wearing protective lab goggles over his black rectangular glasses, using a humming air scribe tool on a flat plate of pale ash-grey volcanic tuff matrix. Brittle ash flakes fly back as he exposes the delicate, bird-like claw elements of a Xiaotingia specimen under brilliant overhead lab lighting. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
